segments.text: So Erthing is a process where the electrical energy which is discharged

segments.text: So it is immediately discharged directly to the earth.
segments.zh: 会立即直接泄放到大地，

segments.text: And for this the low resistance wire is taken help from here.

segments.text: So this is a complete process in which the electrical energy is transferred directly to the earth.
segments.zh: 所以这是一个完整的过程，电能在其中被直接传导到大地，

segments.text: So this is called electrical Erthing here.
segments.zh: 这在这里就叫做电气接地。

segments.text: Now in this electrical earth the non-current carrying part of the equipment or the electrical supply system is connected to the ground.
segments.zh: 在这种电气接地中，设备或供电系统中不载流的部分被连接到大地，

segments.text: And here most of the galvanized iron is used for earthing.
segments.zh: 而这里接地大多使用镀锌铁。

segments.text: Now because of earthing the leakage current provides a simple part here.
segments.zh: 由于接地，泄漏电流在这里有了一条简单的路径。

segments.text: Along with this if there is a short circuit in the equipment then its current passes here in the earth.
segments.zh: 同时，如果设备发生短路，它的电流就会在这里流入大地，

segments.text: In which zero potential happens.
segments.zh: 大地处于零电位。

segments.text: That is we can say that with the help of earthing we protect the system here.
segments.zh: 也就是说，我们可以说，借助接地我们在这里保护了系统，

segments.text: Along with this we protect the equipment from being damaged.
segments.zh: 同时也保护设备免受损坏。

segments.text: Now in the form of practical we also know that if we do not provide earthing then what will happen?
segments.zh: 现在我们还要通过实际的形式来了解，如果我们不做接地会怎样，

segments.text: And earthing if we provide then what will happen?
segments.zh: 而如果我们做了接地又会怎样。

segments.text: But first we know that why earthing is used or why it needs it.
segments.zh: 但首先我们来了解为什么要使用接地，或者为什么需要接地。

segments.text: So the first point is that whatever leakage current is there then for that we can find a way here.
segments.zh: 第一点是，对于任何泄漏电流，我们可以在这里为它找到一条通路，

segments.text: So that its flow can go to earth then for this we provide earthing here.
segments.zh: 让它能流入大地，为此我们在这里做接地。

segments.text: Then the second point is that whatever leakage current is there then for that whatever electric shock or danger is created here
segments.zh: 然后第二点是，对于任何泄漏电流，由此在这里造成的任何电击或危险，

segments.text: then for that we can save human life here then for that we provide earthing here.
segments.zh: 为此我们可以在这里保护人的生命，为此我们在这里做接地。

segments.text: Third point is that the lightning stroke then for that we can get high rise building structures here so that we provide earthing here.
segments.zh: 第三点是雷击，为此我们可以在这里保护高层建筑结构，所以我们在这里做接地。

segments.text: Then the point is that whatever short circuit is there then for that whatever current is there then for that we provide earthing here.
segments.zh: 然后一点是，对于任何短路，对于由此产生的任何电流，我们在这里做接地。

segments.text: And then the point is that whatever sensitive electronic equipment is there then for that operations we provide earthing here.
segments.zh: 然后一点是，对于任何敏感的电子设备，为了它们的运行，我们在这里做接地。

segments.text: So this is the main point of this fire which is needed for earthing here.
segments.zh: 所以这些就是这里需要接地的主要原因。

segments.text: That is any current leakage is happening here because of the reason.

segments.text: So if a person touches that electrical equipment in such a system then that fire current is in the body of that person.
segments.zh: 所以如果有人在这样的系统中碰到那台电气设备，那么故障电流就会在那个人的身体里，

segments.text: So this is the case of the electrical system where earthing is not provided.
segments.zh: 所以这就是没有做接地的电气系统的情况。

segments.text: Then after that you can see here through the second image that the electrical equipment is here.
segments.zh: 然后在那之后，你们可以通过第二张图看到，这里有一台电气设备，
